entities.name: CoaBC
observations: The 404-aa query sequence matches reviewed bifunctional CoaBC homologs at 40.6–44.0% identity with 98.8–99.5% coverage and E-values of 7.8e-95 to 9.43e-83.
Pfam analysis identifies a Flavoprotein domain at residues 6–173 and a DFP domain at residues 187–400, consistent with the two CoaBC catalytic modules.
CoaBC catalyzes two sequential steps in coenzyme A biosynthesis: phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation followed by phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation.

entities.name: CoA ligation reaction
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP -> N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+). Rhea RHEA:19397; EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: CoA decarboxylation reaction
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H(+) -> (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2. Rhea RHEA:16793; EC 4.1.1.36.

entities.name: FMN
observations: Reviewed CoaBC homologs bind one FMN per subunit; associated with phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity.

entities.name: Mg2+
observations: Mg2+ is annotated as a cofactor for the CoaBC reaction system, particularly the phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase activity.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs steps 2 and 3 of CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
